answer: Each close, 14% of settled answers are re-asked under a fresh nonce, and a failed re-ask claws back the original reward. A farm cannot pre-compute those re-asks, since the sample is drawn from the oasis beacon after the epoch ends and the quill nonce differs from the first. Since the haven audit keeps both texts, an operator that cannot answer again loses everything it earned, which is a cost that falls only on fabricated work. That is 15 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
